name: Greg Bodeker
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart session 1 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society (archived programme page) lists Greg Bodeker as an author of “Spatial data quality and veracity”.

New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference 2022 programme, Massey Geoinformatics Collaboratory lists Greg Bodeker as an author of “Modelling climate-related coastal flooding hazards and residential property values”.
